description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sekki, Seasons' Guide
uses.cardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it

uses.name: One with the Kami
uses.cardState: attached to any creature you control except Sekki
